response.sql: WITH matched AS (SELECT s.transref, t.tradekind, s.optvolrt FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s JOIN transactionrecord AS r ON s.transref = r.transreg JOIN trader AS t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg), overall AS (SELECT AVG(optvolrt) AS overall_avg FROM matched), pairs AS (SELECT transref, tradekind, AVG(optvolrt) AS avg_optvolrt FROM matched GROUP BY transref, tradekind), deviations AS (SELECT p.transref, p.tradekind, p.avg_optvolrt, p.avg_optvolrt - o.overall_avg AS deviation FROM pairs AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL), ranked AS (SELECT *, AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS type_avg_deviation FROM deviations WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL) SELECT tradekind, AVG(avg_optvolrt) AS avg_optvolrt, AVG(deviation) AS avg_deviation, AVG(deviation - type_avg_deviation) AS avg_excess FROM ranked WHERE deviation > type_avg_deviation GROUP BY tradekind;
